pages.text: A rule names what may pass. Press $(o)Add$() on the face screen and the editor opens.$(br2)$(l)Item/Tag$(): an id like $(#4a4)minecraft:iron_ingot$(), or a tag written with a hash, like $(#4a4)#c:ingots$(). Click the slot on the left holding an item to fill both fields from it.

$(l)NBT data$(): optional. Leave it empty to accept any. The button beside it switches between $(o)the NBT must match exactly$() and $(o)it only has to contain this$().$(br2)The second button inverts the rule, so it means everything $(o)but$() this.$(br2)With no rules at all, everything passes.

pages.title: Destinations
pages.text: A rule can be pinned to one place. Record a block face with the $(l:tools/destination)Destination Tool$(/l), then click the rule's destination slot while holding it.$(br2)Whatever that rule matches then goes to that face and nowhere else, whatever the distribution mode says. This is how one cable feeds twenty machines each the thing it needs.

pages.title: Shortcuts
pages.text: Sneak-click an item in your inventory on the face screen to turn it straight into a rule.$(br2)With JEI installed you can drag an ingredient out of JEI onto the editor's slot.
